div.div:
Private Azure service lookup: client -> inbound resolver -> Azure DNS -> linked private zone -> private NIC address. Customer namespace lookup: Azure DNS -> matched ruleset -> outbound endpoint -> corporate DNS. A ruleset link can work
without peering, but direct DNS/IP traffic still needs a reachable network path.
